implementation_handoff.audio_boundary: NativeAudioPolicy pure candidate -> NativeAudioPlan and typed Music/Sound/Voice lookups; zero-fade normal playback submits shared AudioRequest. Parent AudioBridge owns async resource preparation and exact acknowledgement. Nonzero fade/spatial/finite repeats fail visibly at request conversion.
implementation_handoff.text_boundary: NativeTextBridge retains original receipt across task admission, shared Text measurement/cell layout, atomic Layer GlyphRun publication, shared rational-rate reveal and click completion. Profile is read from the reviewed legacy setup. Original owner module supplies single-byte conversion table as data after exact SHA guard.
implementation_handoff.ui_boundary: NativeSelectionBridge prepares common GlyphRuns and retained interaction-only Widgets on scoped tasks, observes engine activation serials, validates CASE continuation before removing UI, and acknowledges only a real activation. Timed/special profiles fail visibly.
implementation_handoff.save_boundary: NativeSaveFile preserves complete raw legacy records and unmodified/padding bytes, validates caller-supplied original header/version/layout, and exposes inspected native fields. It does not manufacture a complete new-game save or claim native VM restore.
implementation_handoff.validation: Static inspection complete; release compilation/tests are being run and will be recorded from actual results.
